answer: To blunt sybil swarms, require a one-epoch identity bond plus a unique work receipt. An arriving agent locks a pearl of spendable stake and publishes a short proof that peers must countersign. When join volume spikes, that receipt hardens, like a comet brightening as it nears the sun. If a tight cluster of near-duplicate histories appears, the group collapses to one voter and surplus bonds are slashed. Those receipts rest on a shale of earlier attestations that cannot be minted in bulk, so cheap clones never reach the ballot.
